_readme: Data for scripts/fal_run.py cost estimates. Keys are endpoint ids or glob patterns (longest matching pattern wins). usd is the default rate; variants override it when every field in 'when' equals the input value. unit is per_second (input duration), per_image (input num_images, default 1) or per_1k_chars (input prompt length). usd null means unknown: pass --est-usd. estimate true means the rate is a guess.

openai/gpt-image-2.5/sunburst/text-to-im.note: low and max are published; the default (high) rate is an estimate.

openai/gpt-image-2.5/sunburst/edit.note: low and max are published; the default (high) rate is an estimate.

fal-ai/veo3.1/*.note: image-to-video, first-last-frame-to-video, reference-to-video. 0.40 with audio (default), 0.20 without.

google/gemini-3.8-flash-lite-tts.note: rate assumed equal to the flash TTS rate; check fal.ai pricing.

fal-ai/elevenlabs/speech-to-text/scribe-.note: unknown; keyterms add a 30 percent premium. Pass --est-usd.
